novelty_basis: Kurth (1987) proves the iff for one-rule systems with the chain condition (length-preserving case); not re-proved by the lab. EXP-C01-08 finds no mismatch among 28,850 ordered pairs (binary k <= 7, ternary k <= 4); the Historian's scratch run found none among 152,928.
statement: For words u != v of equal length, the one-rule system {u -> v} is confluent if and only if every border of u is a border of v.
title: Converse of border containment: u -> v (|u| = |v|) is confluent iff Borders(u) is contained in Borders(v)
